info.name: Go Web API - Complete Collection
info.description:
# Go Web API - Modular REST API

## Environment Setup

**Variables Required:**
- `base_url`: http://localhost:8080/api/v1
- `token`: (auto-set on login)
- `refresh_token`: (auto-set on login)
- `user_id`: (auto-set on login)
- `tenant_slug`: acme6

## Modules

- **Auth**: Authentication & session management  
- **Users**: User CRUD (admin only)  
- **Tenants**: Multi-tenant management  
- **Tracking**: GPS tracking for transport companies

## Valid Enum Values

**company_type**: `school` | `corporate` | `transport_provider`  
**vehicle_status**: `active` | `maintenance` | `inactive`  
**route_type**: `pickup` | `dropoff` | `round_trip`  
**event_type**: `pickup` | `dropoff` | `absence` | `delay`  
**alert_severity**: `low` | `medium` | `high` | `critical`  
**access_level**: `read_only` | `read_write`  

## Quick Start

1. Set `base_url` in environment
2. Run `Auth > Login` to get tokens
3. Tokens auto-save to environment
4. All protected endpoints auto-refresh on 401
